summary: Stereotaxis, Inc. disclosed on Form 8-K its completed acquisition of 100% of Robocath, a French company, via a Share Sale Agreement dated April 14, 2026, and closed on July 7, 2026. The filing supplements risk factors and incorporates the agreement, joinder, purchaser warrant form, and resale organization agreement. No financial terms (price, premium, stake %) are stated. The board's recommendation is not mentioned, nor are advisors. Structurally, the deal used a share sale with a warrant and resale arrangement. Being post-closing, the 8-K serves to update risk disclosures. What to watch: integration risks and any post-closing adjustments.
